title: I'm a solo dev and I built a MOBA esports manager for mobile with an AI coding assistant. Here's what worked and what didn't
author: Early_Flamingo5337
selftext:
After last year's World Championship I wanted to play a manager game about MOBA esports and couldn't find one I liked, so I decided to make it. I've been working on it for months, on my own, in the evenings.

Gales of Gods: MOBA Manager is a mobile manager game: you run a club, draft from 100+ champions in Fearless Bo5 series, and make the calls live while the match plays out on the map. You can start a club in the lowest division and climb to the world championship.

How I used AI:

\- Code: I used Claude as a coding assistant design, the simulation rules and the balance are mine.  
\- Art: the champion and player portraits were made with AI.  
\- Music: the soundtrack is generated in real time by the game's own code.

What worked: going step by step, testing every version on my phone, and writing down every balance decision so the simulation stayed consistent.

It's free on Android, with a few ads at the end of each split.

Happy to answer questions about the workflow, and I'd love feedback on the game.

Google Play: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.kronendgames.galesofgods](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.kronendgames.galesofgods)
